summary: A high-level introduction to AAPS for clinicians: how a DIY closed loop gathers data and adjusts temporary basal rates, how the algorithm's predictions lead to dosing decisions (with four scenarios), and how patients should optimise their settings. Concepts only; it does not walk through app screens.
